title: Generalized scalar curvature and Ricci flow on compact Lie groups
summary: Let $G$ be a compact connected semisimple Lie group, let $Q$ be a bi-invariant metric and let $ρ$ be its Cartan three-form. We prove that every left-invariant generalized Ricci flow with $[H_0]=[ρ]$ exists for all positive time and converges smoothly to a Bismut-Ricci-flat pair without rescaling or pullback. The standard pair uniquely maximizes generalized scalar curvature in its torsion class, and every left-invariant Bismut-Ricci-flat pair on a compact simple group is standard, answering questions of Fusi, Lafuente and Stanfield and of Lauret and Will.
